test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

FAMISH
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'** i.e.** 'Eat'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "famish"** means to suffer from extreme hunger, to starve, or to be deprived of food.( भूखा होना)
 
• **Eat** means to consume food by chewing and swallowing it, satisfying one's hunger or appetite.(खाना)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Eat'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Meanings** of the other given words:

 
 
• **Abstain** means to refrain or hold oneself back from doing something, usually from indulging in a particular behavior, such as eating, drinking, or participating in certain activities.(त्याग करना)
 
• **Refrain:** To refrain means to hold back or restrain oneself from doing something, often voluntarily or out of self-discipline.(सावधानी बरतना)
 
• **Starve: **Starve means to suffer from extreme hunger, to be deprived of food or nourishment for an extended period, leading to malnutrition or starvation.(भूखमरी करना)

The correct answer is 'Option 4' <
